command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

# spawn's task shell does not inherit the image's PATH; conda tools live in /opt/conda/bin
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH

echo "== verify staged inputs against their pinned sha256 =="
printf "%s  %s\n" 61eba5b05ef7d9ae5310e756c1143fa48072de3856d36871bb14e57aa2435ff3 chr20.fa > pins.sha256
printf "%s  %s\n" 4bd24cdfa4486964f070e69b5dd109b6e1e78561783d48c4e62cc6fae3536a00 HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz >> pins.sha256
printf "%s  %s\n" ebd1ad56bc572a4bf157ba21d1ad8ef074ea25f02eb2d982d9f0089180d82a04 HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz >> pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== arm64 from inside: ELF e_machine must be 183 (AArch64) =="
BM2=$(command -v bwa-mem2)
EM=$(od -An -tu1 -j18 -N2 "$BM2" | awk '{print $1 + $2*256}')
echo "e_machine $EM"
test "$EM" -eq 183

echo "== bwa-mem2 version (package tag says 2.3; the binary self-reports) =="
bwa-mem2 version

echo "== bwa-mem2 index (note: larger than bwa's, measured below) =="
bwa-mem2 index chr20.fa
ls -l chr20.fa.0123 chr20.fa.bwt.2bit.64 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$5} END {print "mem2_index_bytes", s}' > idx_sizes.txt

echo "== bwa-mem2 mem -t 8 (identical flags to the bwa leg) =="
bwa-mem2 mem -t 8 -R "@RG\tID:smoke\tSM:HG00096\tPL:ILLUMINA\tLB:SRR062634" chr20.fa HG00096_chr20smoke_1.fq.gz HG00096_chr20smoke_2.fq.gz > aln_mem2.sam

echo "== EXACT IDENTITY: every primary alignment must match bwa on chr,pos,MAPQ,flag =="
# portable bit tests (no gawk and()): secondary=0x100, supplementary=0x800, mate from 0x40/0x80
key() { awk -F'\t' '!/^@/ {f=$2; if (int(f/256)%2==0 && int(f/2048)%2==0) { m=(int(f/64)%2)?1:((int(f/128)%2)?2:0); print $1"/"m"\t"$3"\t"$4"\t"$5"\t"f } }' "$1" | LC_ALL=C sort; }
key aln_bwa.sam  > k_bwa.txt
key aln_mem2.sam > k_mem2.txt
N_BWA=$(wc -l < k_bwa.txt); N_M2=$(wc -l < k_mem2.txt)
DIFFS=$(cmp -l k_bwa.txt k_mem2.txt 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
IDENTICAL=no; cmp -s k_bwa.txt k_mem2.txt && IDENTICAL=yes

{
  echo "bwa-mem2 vs bwa -- exact primary-alignment identity on shared staged bytes"
  echo "mem2_version          $(bwa-mem2 version 2>&1 | tail -1)"
  echo "primary_bwa           $N_BWA   (expect 800000)"
  echo "primary_mem2          $N_M2   (expect 800000)"
  echo "identical_primaries   $IDENTICAL   (expect yes -- exact, no MAPQ gating)"
  echo "differing_bytes       $DIFFS   (expect 0)"
  cat idx_sizes.txt
  echo "note  bwa-mem2 is designed to reproduce bwa mem's output; this asserts it, it does not assume it"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$IDENTICAL" = yes
test "$N_BWA" -eq 800000
test "$N_M2" -eq 800000
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
